interpretation.evidence_standard: No treatment receives MVA actual-allele muscle-efficacy credit without that measurement. Cell-level compensation, genetic rescue, unrelated functional benefit, assay perturbation, toxicity and tumor killing remain distinct. This applies equally to current niacin and apitegromab nominees.
